definition: AMPS proposal: putative high-energy near-horizon structure for infallers in a resolution of black-hole quantum-information consistency constraints; not an established classical membrane or detected radiation source.

references.role: small-corrections argument and horizon microstructure context

open_quantities_not_assumed: Page-time status and quantum state of any target black hole
Effective stress-energy tensor or thickness of a physical firewall
Local energy deposition and massive particle interactions with a proposed firewall
Conservation-compatible emitted photons and their escape distribution
Spectral signature, luminosity, distance and detector response
future_gate: Develop explicit quantum-state-specific, backreaction-consistent firewall or no-firewall models; compare falsifiable observables before applying a physical claim to BHB.
